Bata
from Saka is an Egyptian bull-god of the
New Kingdom
, who represents together with his brother
Anubis
the 17th Upper Egyptian
Nome
.
History
Until the middle of the
Eighteenth Dynasty
Bata was represented as a ram and later as a bull. Bata is probably identical with the death god
Bt
of the Egyptian
Old Kingdom
, known from the
Saqqara
necropolis, for instance from the
Mastaba of Ti
. Bata is not mentioned in the
Pyramid Texts
and
Coffin Texts
.
In literature
Bata is the name of the protagonist in the
Tale of Two Brothers
, a copy of which survives on the
New Kingdom
Papyrus D’Orbiney
, where he is the brother of Anubis. He is also mentioned in the
Ptolemaic
Papyrus Jumilhac.
